findings.evidence: all_files skips every path whose basename is SHA256SUMS. A temporary nested/SHA256SUMS was modified after write_manifest; verify_manifest still returned PASS with files_verified1 while actual payload files were2.

findings.title: Nested SHA256SUMS files are excluded from supposedly complete manifest

findings.evidence: Publication moves files individually, then REPORT, then SHA256SUMS. A failure after some moves leaves evidence subdirectories; the next execute rejects every existing directory at lines265-267. A failure moving/verifying the final manifest may leave REPORT visible without completed bundle receipt.
findings.requested_fix: Use a recoverable final publication protocol with a completion marker/report exposed only after the published payload+manifest verification, or atomically publish a complete directory while preserving prior provenance. Preserve failed staging and permit validated resume.
findings.title: Partial publication is not recoverable and can expose REPORT before manifest
